definitions.name: S0A.RUNSTARTS
definitions.body: 'V' BIND 0 V LENGTH 1 SUB RANGE [ 'I' BIND I 0 EQ NOT V I GET V I 1 SUB GET EQ AND NOT ] FILTER
definitions.note: Vector -> ascending indices where a run of equal adjacent values begins

definitions.name: S0A.DEDUPE
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V V S0A.RUNSTARTS GET
definitions.note: Vector -> Vector with each run of equal adjacent values collapsed to one

definitions.name: S0A.RLE
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V S0A.RUNSTARTS 'S' BIND S 1 DROP V LENGTH 1 COLLECT CONCAT S SUB 'C' BIND V S GET C 2 COLLECT ZIP
definitions.note: Vector -> run-length encoding, a Vector of [ value count ] pairs

definitions.name: S0A.UPRUNS
definitions.body: 'V' BIND 0 V LENGTH 1 SUB RANGE 0 [ 'I' BIND 'A' BIND A 1 ADD 1 I 0 GT V I GET V I 1 SUB GET GT AND SELECT ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: non-empty Vector -> length of the longest strictly increasing adjacent stretch

definitions.name: S0A.SECOND-LARGEST
definitions.body: UNIQUE SORT 'U' BIND U -2 GET 'X' BIND NIL X U LENGTH 2 LT SELECT
definitions.note: Vector -> second-largest distinct value, or NIL when fewer than two distinct values

definitions.name: S0A.MAJORITY
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V TALLY 'T' BIND T KEYS 'K' BIND T VALUES 'C' BIND K 0 K LENGTH 1 SUB RANGE [ 'I' BIND C I GET 2 MUL V LENGTH GT ] FILTER GET 'M' BIND M 0 GET 'X' BIND NIL X M LENGTH 0 EQ SELECT
definitions.note: Vector -> value occurring in more than half the positions, or NIL

definitions.name: S0A.DIVISORS
definitions.body: 'N' BIND 1 N RANGE [ 'D' BIND N D DIV 'Q' BIND Q Q FLOOR EQ ] FILTER
definitions.note: positive integer -> ascending Vector of its positive divisors

definitions.name: S0A.PRIME?
definitions.body: S0A.DIVISORS LENGTH 2 EQ
definitions.note: positive integer -> TRUE when it is prime

definitions.name: S0A.PRIMES
definitions.body: 'N' BIND 1 N RANGE [ S0A.PRIME? ] FILTER
definitions.note: positive integer N -> ascending Vector of primes <= N

definitions.name: S0A.BINARY
definitions.body: 'N' BIND N 2 N 0 RANGE POW DIV FLOOR 'Q' BIND Q Q 2 DIV FLOOR 2 MUL SUB 'B' BIND 0 N RANGE [ 'I' BIND Q I GET 0 GT ] FILTER 'K' BIND B K GET STR JOIN
definitions.note: positive integer -> its base-2 String without leading zeros

definitions.name: S0A.COLLATZ-STEP
definitions.body: 'X' BIND X 2 DIV 'H' BIND 1 H X 3 MUL 1 ADD H FLOOR H EQ SELECT X 1 EQ SELECT
definitions.note: x -> next Collatz value (1 stays 1)

definitions.name: S0A.COLLATZ
definitions.body: 'N' BIND 1 250 RANGE N [ 'I' BIND S0A.COLLATZ-STEP ] SCAN N 1 COLLECT CONCAT [ 1 GT ] FILTER LENGTH
definitions.note: positive integer (total stopping time <= 250) -> Collatz steps to reach 1

definitions.name: S0A.DIGITAL-ROOT
definitions.body: 1 SUB 'M' BIND M M 9 DIV FLOOR 9 MUL SUB 1 ADD
definitions.note: positive integer -> digital root, 1 + (n-1) mod 9

definitions.name: S0A.FIB-INDEX
definitions.body: 'N' BIND 1 N 2 ADD RANGE [ 0 1 ] [ 'I' BIND [ 'A' 'B' ] BIND B A B ADD 2 COLLECT ] SCAN [ 0 GET ] MAP [ N LT ] FILTER LENGTH 1 ADD
definitions.note: positive integer N -> smallest k with F(k) >= N (F(1)=F(2)=1)

definitions.name: S0A.BRACKET-STEP
definitions.body: 'C' BIND 'S' BIND S C 2 COLLECT JOIN '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE
definitions.note: reduced String, char -> append char then cancel a trailing () or []

definitions.name: S0A.BRACKET-REDUCE
definitions.body: CHARS '' [ S0A.BRACKET-STEP ] FOLD
definitions.note: bracket String -> what remains after deleting all adjacent matched pairs

definitions.name: S0A.BRACKET-REDUCTIONS
definitions.body: CHARS '' [ S0A.BRACKET-STEP ] SCAN
definitions.note: bracket String -> Vector of the reduced form of each non-empty prefix

definitions.name: S0A.BALANCED?
definitions.body: S0A.BRACKET-REDUCE '' EQ
definitions.note: bracket String -> TRUE when properly nested and matched (empty is balanced)

definitions.name: S0A.UNMATCHED
definitions.body: S0A.BRACKET-REDUCE CHARS LENGTH
definitions.note: bracket String -> count of chars left after deleting matched pairs repeatedly

definitions.name: S0A.BALANCED-PREFIX
definitions.body: S0A.BRACKET-REDUCTIONS 'R' BIND '' 1 COLLECT R CONCAT 'P' BIND 0 P LENGTH 1 SUB RANGE [ 'L' BIND P L GET '' EQ ] FILTER 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: bracket String -> length of the longest balanced prefix

definitions.name: S0A.BRACKET-DEPTH
definitions.body: CHARS [ 'C' BIND 1 -1 C '(' EQ NOT C '[' EQ NOT AND NOT SELECT ] MAP 0 [ ADD 0 MAX ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: bracket String -> max open-bracket count, counter +1 on open, -1 on close, never below 0
